f.title: Submit postmarketing ICSRs to AEMS via ESG NextGen in ICH E2B(R3) from October 1, 2026
f.statement: For postmarketing ICSRs for human drug products, biological products, and drug- or biologic-led combination products submitted via ESG NextGen, beginning October 1, 2026, the ICSRs must be submitted to the FDA Adverse Event Monitoring System (AEMS, formerly FAERS) database using ICH E2B(R3) data standards (the ICH E2B(R3) Implementation Guidance, incorporating the FDA Regional Implementation Guide and its regional data elements).
f.applicability: Postmarketing ICSRs and ICSR attachments for human drug products, biological products and drug- or biologic-led combination products submitted to AEMS via ESG NextGen
f.exceptions: Does not apply to ICSRs submitted through the Safety Reporting Portal.
f.systems: ICH E2B(R3); FDA AEMS; ESG NextGen; FDA Regional Implementation Guide for E2B(R3)
f.processes: E2B / transmission; Submission operations; Safety system configuration

f.title: E2B(R2) postmarketing ICSRs accepted only through September 30, 2026
f.statement: FDA will continue to accept postmarketing ICSRs prepared under the ICH E2B(R2) data standards (per the Specifications for Preparing and Submitting Electronic ICSRs and ICSR Attachments) through September 30, 2026, and intends to no longer accept E2B(R2) ICSRs for human drug products, biological products and drug- or biologic-led combination products after that date.

f.title: Move to E2B(R3) earlier where reporting requirements need it (e.g. 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v))
f.statement: FDA requires ICSRs submitted through ESG NextGen to be in the ICH E2B(R3) data standards beginning October 1, 2026, unless an earlier transition to ICH E2B(R3) is needed to accommodate reporting requirements, for example 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v), added by the final rule Nonprescription Drug Product With an Additional Condition for Nonprescription Use (89 FR 105288, December 26, 2024).
f.applicability: Postmarketing ICSRs and ICSR attachments for human drug products, biological products and drug- or biologic-led combination products submitted to AEMS via ESG NextGen; in particular products subject to 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v) (nonprescription drug product with an additional condition for nonprescription use)

f.title: Once E2B(R3) submission has begun, use E2B(R3) for all ICSRs
f.statement: Once an applicant, specified nonapplicant, or responsible person for a company with reporting requirements has begun submitting ICSRs in the ICH E2B(R3) data standards format, all its ICSR submissions are expected to use this data standard.

f.title: E2B(R3) requirement applies only to ESG NextGen; companies without E2B(R3) capability may use the SRP
f.statement: FDA offers two routes for electronic submission of ICSRs and ICSR attachments to AEMS: direct submission through ESG NextGen, or the Safety Reporting Portal (SRP), which serves applicants, specified nonapplicants and responsible persons without ICH E2B(R3) data standards capability. This notice on the use of ICH E2B(R3) data standards applies only to submission of ICSRs and ICSR attachments through ESG NextGen.

f.title: Check the FDA AEMS electronic submissions web page for the latest technical specifications
f.statement: Because the ICH E2B(R3) FDA Regional Implementation Guidance (data elements, electronic transport format, types of ICSR attachments) is periodically updated, submitters should check the FDA AEMS Electronic Submissions web page to ensure they have the most recent version of the technical specifications document and for additional information on electronic submissions to AEMS.
